subject: MedNexa: Security ops intake + VPC/on-prem options
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@mednexa.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: MedNexa: Security ops intake + VPC/on-prem options

Thanks for the time today, Alex — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary ask: private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with strict network isolation for PHI workloads.
- Compliance drivers: HIPAA + EU data residency for a subset of patients, and an upcoming procurement questionnaire.
- Risk blockers: audit evidence for encryption at rest (keys), SOC 2 status, and network diagram that shows how traffic is restricted between services.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Alex: can you confirm current SOC 2 status (Type I/II + latest report window) and point us to any existing evidence we can reference?
2) Alex: please share any internal network diagram or architecture snapshot that shows how MedNexa intends to host the inference workload (VPC peering, on-prem cluster, or air-gapped site).
3) Marissa / Karthik (cc’d): I’m attaching a short RFI template (redwood_rfi_template_v2.docx) — please fill the security section where it helps speed procurement.
4) I’ll pull together a draft technical approach for VPC and air-gapped options and return by EOD Friday.

Attachment: redwood_rfi_template_v2.docx

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0102

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@mednexa.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@mednexa.com; Procurement <procurement@mednexa.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedNexa: Security ops intake + VPC/on-prem options

Thanks, Sean — great to meet. Short answers and attachments below.

SOC 2 status
- We completed SOC 2 Type I in March 2026 and our Type II audit is in progress (control window: Jan–Apr 2027). Expected final report delivery: mid-June 2027.

Network posture
- Attached a high-level network snapshot (mednexa_network_snapshot.png) that shows our preferred model: dedicated VPCs per environment, strict IGW/NAT gating, and optional on-prem appliance for air-gapped processing.
- We are evaluating HSM-backed key management (AWS KMS w/ external key material) for production PHI work.

Procurement / questionnaire
- Procurement requested the RFI be returned with vendor evidence where possible — I attached a short security overview (mednexa_security_overview.pdf) and we can accept your populated RFI template.
- Procurement will need a SOW + preliminary cost estimate to evaluate budget impact; they asked to loop in legal for any data residency clauses.

Attachments: mednexa_security_overview.pdf, mednexa_network_snapshot.png

Next steps
- I’ll route the RFI to our security lead after you return it filled.
- If you can provide a sample network/segmentation diagram from Redwood that corresponds to the VPC + optional air-gap model, that would speed internal sign-off.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Infrastructure Security
MedNexa Health
alex.johnson@mednexa.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MedNexa: Security ops intake + VPC/on-prem options (internal tasks)

Karthik — forwarding Alex’s note. Can you own the following for our ask-back to MedNexa?

Action items for Karthik
- Produce a concise network segmentation diagram (PNG) that maps Redwood’s private deployment patterns to Alex’s mednexa_network_snapshot.png. Two variants: (1) Dedicated VPC peering + private endpoints; (2) On-prem air-gapped appliance with secure data ingestion flow.
- Draft 1-page crypto & key management answers (KMS/HSM approach, rotation, BYOK options).
- Annotate any controls we can provide for SOC 2 evidence (logging retention, access review cadence, encryption at rest details).

Timeline: please deliver drafts by Fri 2027-05-14 17:00 PDT so I can bundle with the RFI and send back to Alex early next week.

Also note: include attachment stubs for the diagrams when you reply so procurement sees the filenames.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedNexa: Security ops intake + VPC/on-prem options

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement asked me to include these additional items when you return the RFI: 
- Attach a sample SDLC security policy excerpt or link to our security questionnaire responses.
- Preliminary pricing band (range ok) for the dedicated VPC variant and an estimate for on-prem appliance support/installation.
- If you have a published SLA for private deployments (latency/uptime) please point to it — procurement will evaluate against our vendor baseline.

I’m attaching the security overview and network snapshot again for clarity. When you send the RFI back, please include filenames in the email body (e.g., redwood_vpc_diagram_v1.png, redwood_kms_summary.pdf) so procurement can track attachments.

DocuSign / procurement path: I’ve routed a DocuSign placeholder for an NDA/SOW baseline (DocuSign: 0xMED-4729). Procurement contact is Laura Peters (procurement@mednexa.com).

Thanks — looking forward to the drafts.
Alex
